Namida no Soukoban Special

Famicom Disk System

Namida no Soukoban Special

Released ByKingMike'

StatusFully Playable

Last Modified 31 October 2017

Game Description:

Namida no Soukoban Special (roughly translated as “Tears of Sokoban”) is ASCII’s take on the popular Japanese warehouse puzzle. The player navigates several warehouse floors, pushing crates along a square grid with the goal of aligning the crates on specific floor tiles. The player can only push crates, not drag them, and must be careful not to box themselves or the crates into a deadlocked position.

Translation Description:

This is an English translation of Namida no Soukoban Special for the Family Computer Disk System.
